CIP-007-6 R5 Part 5.2 requires the following:

"Identify and inventory all known enabled default or other generic account types, either by system, by groups of systems, by location, or by system type(s)" [csection-ec458b69bb605a5c345a].

The following document shows that the operator performs this duty:

*   **CIP Cyber Security Policy — 3.4.5 System Access Controls Process (R5)**: This document states that "LSPG shall document and implement a system access control process to: ... Identify and inventory all known enabled default or other generic account types, either by system, by groups of systems, by location, or by system type(s) (Part 5.2)" [isection-fbc9ce9e2439c4f4af90].
